For other versions, use one of these documentation indexes: - v2 (default): https://developer.ideogram.ai/v2/llms.txt - v1: https://developer.ideogram.ai/v1/llms.txt Tools are outcome-focused endpoints: you describe the result you want, and Ideogram chooses and manages the underlying models. Use a tool when you don’t need to pick a specific model contract. Tool What it does Remove Background Isolate the subject on a transparent background Replace Background Keep the subject, generate a new background from a prompt Remove Object Erase an object and fill in the scene Remove Logos Detect supplied reference logos and erase them Reframe Extend an image to a new aspect ratio Advertisement Resizer Adapt an ad creative to multiple target sizes Colorways Recolor masked regions of a product photo to target colors Material Swap Re-render a masked region in the material of a reference image Layerize Text Split text from an image into editable layers If you need direct control over a specific model and its request contract, use the model endpoints under Generate Images and Edit Images instead.
